title: Gamma Cygni Nebula (Sadr Region)
description: A diffuse emission nebula and H II region surrounding the star Sadr (Gamma Cygni), which marks the center of the Northern Cross asterism in Cygnus.

title: Dumbbell Nebula
description: One of the brightest planetary nebulae in the sky, formed from the outer layers of gas shed by a dying star in the constellation Vulpecula.

title: Cooling Tower Cluster
description: A compact open star cluster in Cygnus, roughly 4,000 light-years away, containing a handful of hot, young, blue stars.

title: Messier 56
description: A moderately dense globular cluster in the constellation Lyra, located roughly 33,000 light-years from Earth.

title: Messier 71
description: A loosely concentrated globular cluster in the small constellation Sagitta, once debated as either a dense open cluster or a sparse globular cluster.

title: Messier 75
description: A compact, highly concentrated globular cluster in Sagittarius, around 67,500 light-years away.

title: Eastern Veil Nebula
description: The brightest part of the Eastern half of the Veil Nebula, a large supernova remnant in Cygnus left behind by a star that exploded 10,000-20,000 years ago.
